verdict.rationale: Datadog documents offline Experiments (versioned datasets, comparing results) and an evaluations submission API. The pack does not show evals running in a CI pipeline or deployments being gated on eval results. The only merge-blocking evidence is for code coverage thresholds, which is a different feature and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results
